content: Non-SOME/IP data exchange between two communication endpoints Non-SOME/IP data exchange between two SocketAddress es is de- scribed with the StaticSocketConnection element that is aggregated by a Sock- etAddress in the role StaticSocketConnection . The aggregating SocketAd- dress describes one communication endpoint. The referenced StaticSocketCon- nection . remoteAddress defines the second communication endpoint.
